guideDescription: A fresh-level-80 path into Bear Form threat, Rage discipline, active recovery, dungeon control, and later raid progression.

mechanics.label: Forms
mechanics.use: Enter Dire Bear Form before contact and change form only when the tank assignment and incoming damage permit it.

mechanics.label: Resources
mechanics.use: Generate Rage safely and queue Maul only when the next required Mangle, Lacerate, Swipe, or control global remains funded.

mechanics.label: Bleeds
mechanics.use: Maintain Lacerate on durable targets and use Mangle to support threat and bleed damage without losing pack control.

mechanics.label: Survival
mechanics.use: Plan mitigation, health buffers, recovery, taunts, stuns, and emergency pack control before the damage spike arrives.

talent.name: Fresh-80 self-contained mono-Bear baseline
talent.summary: Use the fully allocated Bear build for mitigation, threat, Rage, recovery, and dungeon control. Document exact debuff-coverage swaps before adopting a raid-composition variant.

pageDescriptions.quickStart: Start at level 80 with Dire Bear Form, pull control, Rage discipline, survival rules, and a practical dungeon-ready checklist.
pageDescriptions.playing: Manage threat, Rage, Maul queues, Lacerate, packs, taunts, cooldowns, movement, and utility as one tanking system.
pageDescriptions.setup: Install the 0/60/11 build, glyphs, form controls, original-client macros, addons, and defensive tracking.
pageDescriptions.building: Build effective health and armor first, then compare Agility, hit, expertise, avoidance, threat, budget gems, and enchants.
pageDescriptions.equipping: Target normal and heroic dungeon, reputation, crafted, emblem, catch-up, ToC, ICC, and Ruby Sanctum tank upgrades.
pageDescriptions.raiding: Handle boss positioning, swaps, adds, cooldowns, survival sets, utility assignments, and encounters by mode.

serverNote: Standard original-client WotLK 3.3.5a behavior is the baseline. Verify Savage Defense, Survival of the Fittest, Maul queueing, Growl hit rules, Lacerate threat, and encounter-specific debuff immunities on Hellscream.
footer: Unofficial player-made Hellscream guide. Verify live tooltips, raid assignments, and server scripting.
